controls_nrpn.description: Every PreenFM2 patch parameter by NRPN (CC 99/98 number, CC 6/38 value; the synth applies it on CC 38). Values are in the synth's own units; parameters with scale 100 are sent as (value - min) * 100. The synth's MIDI Receive setting must include NRPN (default: CC & NRPN). From the PreenFM2 firmware (Ixox/preenfm2, MidiDecoder::decodeNrpn).
controls_nrpn.guide: Sound design: operators are sine-wave (or other Shape) oscillators. The Algorithm decides which are carriers (heard, level = Mix N for the Nth carrier) and which are modulators (each feeds another operator through an IM connection; IM depth and the modulator frequency ratio set the brightness and harmonic content). Carrier envelopes shape loudness over time; modulator envelopes shape brightness over time. Start from init (a plain sine) or from a preset read with read_nrpn_patch.

stages.title: Sound source
stages.hint: The algorithm wires the operators together: carriers are heard, modulators bend the operator they point to, by the modulation index of that link. Per operator, the apex sets attack, the end release and the middle dot the frequency ratio.

stages.title: Mixer and filter
stages.hint: Level and pan of the carrier voices, then the filter.

stages.title: Modulation
stages.hint: Three LFOs and the modulation matrix: pick a source on the left, a target on the right, and set how much with the knobs. The wheel and the four Performance knobs are sources you move by hand; point a matrix row at one to use it.

stages.title: Arpeggiator
stages.hint: Plays held notes as a pattern.

note: PreenFM2 is 4-timbre multitimbral (channels 1-4). Presets: Bank Select CC 0 (2 = DX7 banks 0-127; 3 = DX7 banks 128-255) then CC 32 (bank number), then Program Change; per midi.guide. CC labels follow midi.guide. A DX7 bank holds 32 voices, so preset N is bank N div 32, program N mod 32 (checked on hardware: Program Change above 31 does nothing). CC numbers checked against the firmware (MidiDecoder.h): arpeggiator CC 100-105, Op 1 attack CC 65.
